item.title: Ahn Gyu-back: "Current Ground Operations Commander Removed from Duty for Involvement in Martial Law" (안규백 “현 지상작전사령관 계엄 연루 직무배제”)
item.description:
Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-back announced on the 12th, "As of today, Ground Operations Commander (Army General) Joo Sung-woon is being removed from his duties." The Ministry of National Defense has also requested an investigation regarding Commander Joo. Minister Ahn explained during the announcement of the interim investigation results by the Ministry of Defense's Constitution Respect Task Force (TF) that there was a report linking Commander Joo to the emergency martial law, and upon review, an investigation was deemed necessary, leading to the removal from duty. (안규백 국방장관이 12일 “주성운 지상작전사령관(육군 대장)에 대해서 오늘 부로 직무 배제한다”고 밝혔다. 국방부는 관련해 주 사령관에 대해 수사의뢰도 실시했다. 안 장관은 이날 국방부 헌법존중 TF 중간 조사 결과 발표에서 주 사령관이 비상계엄과 연루됐다는 제보가 있어 확인한 결과 수사가 필요해 직무배제 조치를 했다고 설명했다.)

Commander Joo was appointed as the Ground Operations Commander in the first four-star general personnel reshuffle following the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration. He served as the commander of the 1st Corps during the emergency martial law period. (주 사령관은 이재명 정부 출범 이후 첫 4성 장군 인사에서 지상작전사령관에 보임됐다. 비상 계엄 당시 1군단장을 지냈다.)

During the National Assembly's audit of state affairs last October, Commander Joo stated, "I deeply apologize for the concern caused to the public by the fact that some parts of our military were involved in acts of insurrection during the illegal emergency martial law." (주 사령관은 지난해 10월 국방위 국정감사에서 “불법적인 비상계엄 시 우리 군 일부가 내란 행위에 가담해 국민 여러분께 심려를 끼쳐드린 점에 대해 깊은 사과의 말씀을 드린다”고 밝힌 바 있다.)

When asked whether he, as the 1st Corps commander during the martial law period, had instructed preparations for a (regional) military-police joint situation room under Defense Condition (DEFCON) 2, he answered that he had not. (그는 계엄 당시 1군단장으로서 경계태세 2급에 따른 (지역) 군경합동상황실 준비도 지시했느냐는 물음에는 지시하지 않았다고 답했다.)

He assumed the position of Ground Operations Commander last September. (그는 작년 9월 지작사령관에 취임했다.)

Commander Joo was serving as the commander of the 1st Corps during the December 3 emergency martial law. The Ministry of Defense's Investigation Headquarters reportedly obtained a report suggesting that Commander Joo had contacted the former commander of the 2nd Armored Brigade under the 1st Corps, Gu Sam-hoe, during the martial law period and is currently verifying the facts of the matter. Former Brigade Commander Gu was designated as the head of the 2nd Investigation Division of the Joint Investigation Headquarters, which was to investigate election fraud suspicions immediately after the declaration of the December 3 martial law. (주 사령관은 12·3 비상계엄 당시 제1군단장을 맡고 있었다. 국방부 조사본부는 주 사령관이 계엄 당시 1군단 예하 구삼회 전 육군 제2기갑여단장과 연락했다는 취지의 제보를 입수 후 해당 내용의 사실관계를 파악 중인 것으로 전해졌다. 구 전 단장은 12·3 계엄 선포 직후 부정선거 의혹을 조사하기 위한 합동수사본부 제2수사단장으로 지목된 바 있다.)

It is also known that the Ministry of Defense is looking into the possibility that Commander Joo, during his tenure as 1st Corps commander, prepared for a point-of-origin strike against North Korean trash-carrying balloon provocations and was involved in unmanned aerial vehicle operations of the Drone Operations Command. (국방부는 주 사령관이 1군단장 시절 북한 오물풍선 도발 지점 원점타격을 준비하고, 드론작전사령부의 무인기 작전과 연관됐을 가능성도 살펴보고 있는 것으로 알려졌다.)

This measure has led to criticism that the Ministry of Defense's verification process for general-level appointments has effectively failed. When the Ministry conducted a personnel reshuffle replacing all four-star generals last September, it stated, "We prioritized excellent capabilities and expertise to perform duties with a loyal sense of mission towards the nation and its people and to lead strong defense reforms." However, less than half a year after appointing that four-star general, he has been removed from duty for 'involvement in martial law.' (이번 조치로 국방부의 장성 인사검증이 사실상 실패했다는 지적도 나온다. 국방부는 지난해 9월 4성 전원을 물갈이하는 인사를 하면서 “국가와 국민에 대한 충직한 사명감으로 임무를 수행하며, 강력한 국방개혁을 선도적으로 이끌 수 있는 우수한 능력과 전문성을 우선 고려했다”고 했다. 하지만 그렇게 임명한 4성 장군을 채 반년도 되지 않아 ‘계엄 연루’라며 직무 배제한 것이다.)

Meanwhile, the Ministry of Defense's Constitution Respect TF has identified approximately 180 individuals directly or indirectly involved in the martial law, and among them, 114 have been or are under investigation. Additionally, it has been decided to request disciplinary action against 48 individuals (including those overlapping with investigation targets) and to issue warnings or cautions to 75 individuals. (한편 국방부 헌법존중TF는 계엄에 직·간접적으로 관여된 인원 180여 명을 파악해 이 중 114명을 수사의뢰했거나 수사 중이다. 또한 수사대상과 중복된 인원을 포함해 48명은 징계요구, 75명은 경고 및 주의 조치하기로 했다.)

The Ministry of Defense also stated that it is proceeding with disciplinary procedures against those for whom disciplinary action has been requested and those indicted based on previous investigation results, and severe disciplinary measures have been taken against 35 individuals so far. As of now, 29 individuals have appealed. (국방부는 아울러 기존 조사 결과에 따라 징계요구된 인원과 기소된 인원 등을 대상으로 징계 절차를 밟고 있으며 현재까지 35명에 대한 중징계 조치가 이뤄졌다고 밝혔다. 현재 기준 29명이 항고한 상태다.)

The Constitution Respect TF is being dissolved as of today. Regarding suspicions deeply involving organizations like the Defense Security Command and the Intelligence Command in the martial law, which have not been fully clarified due to the sensitive nature of handling classified information, the 'Insurrection Dedicated Investigation Headquarters,' led by Park Jeong-hoon, head of the Ministry of Defense Investigation Headquarters (Marine Brigadier General), is expected to continue the investigation. (헌법존중TF는 이날로 해체되며, 국방부는 방첩사와 정보사 등 계엄에 깊이 관여했지만 기밀정보를 다루는 조직의 특수성으로 아직 충분히 밝히지 못한 의혹에 대해서는 박정훈 국방부조사본부장(해병 준장)이 이끄는 ‘내란전담수사본부’가 수사를 이어갈 예정이다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] NIS: "Kim Ju-ae Has Opinions on Some Policies... Succession Designation Phase" ([속보] 국정원 “김주애, 일부 시책에 의견…후계 내정 단계")
item.description:
The National Intelligence Service (NIS) stated on the 12th regarding Kim Ju-ae, the daughter of North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong Un, "In the past, we expressed that Kim Ju-ae was in 'successor training,' but we now judge it to be the 'designation phase.'" The NIS reported this to the National Assembly Intelligence Committee today, according to ruling and opposition party floor leaders, Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker Park Seon-won and People Power Party lawmaker Lee Seong-gwan. (국정원은 12일 김정은 북한 국무위원장의 딸 김주애에 대해 “과거 김주애는 후계자 수업 중이라고 표현을 해왔는데 이제는 ‘내정단계’라고 판단된다”라고 밝혔다. 국정원은 이날 국회 정보위원회에 이같이 보고했다고 여야 간사인 더불어민주당 박선원 의원과 국민의힘 이성권 의원이 밝혔다.)

Furthermore, the NIS said, "Based on factors such as her attendance at military-related events like the Air Force Festival, visits to the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun—a symbol of hereditary succession—and expressing opinions on some policies during on-site inspections, it is assessed that she has moved from successor training to the succession designation phase." (또 국정원은 “공군절 행사 참석 등 군과 관련한 행사를 참석했던 부분, 혈통 계승의 상징인 금수산 궁전 참배, 현장 시찰할 때 일부 시책에 의견을 내는 등으로 미뤄봤을 때, 후계자 수업에서 후계 내정단계로 접어들었다”고 했다.)

Regarding North Korea's 9th Party Congress, it stated, "Possible dates for the party congress include February 16th, the birthday of Kim Jong Il, and it is highly likely to be held after the Lunar New Year holiday. It is expected to proceed as an internal event for about 7 days without foreign delegations." (북한의 9차 당 대회에 대해서는 “당 대회 개최일로 예상되는 건 김정일 생일인 2월 16일이 있고, 설 연휴 지난 이후가 가능성이 높다. 약 7일간 외국 대표단 없이 내부행사로 진행될 것”이라고 했다.)

Concerning the South Korean government's work to amend the Criminal Code to change the term 'enemy state' to 'foreign country' in the espionage law, the NIS expressed its position that "it should be swiftly passed from the Legislation and Judiciary Committee to the plenary session," adding, "The NIS will revise enforcement decrees and activity regulations/guidelines and work at the forefront to diligently carry out its mission to root out espionage, protect national interests, and safeguard sensitive national interests and core technologies." (우리 정부에서 형법 개정을 통해 간첩법상 ‘적국’이라는 조항을 ‘외국’으로 고치는 작업과 관련해서는 “법사위에서 본회의로 올려져서 신속 통과돼야 한다는 입장”이라며 “국정원은 시행령 개정과 활동 규정 지침을 바꿔 간첩 소탕과 국익 수호 민감 국익 핵심 기술 보호를 위해 최선두에서 열심히 임무 수행하겠다”고 했다.)
